description: Record a human's approval of a purchase on any payment rail. BotSupply does not hold or move the money. Returns receipt_id, a public receipt_url, and an edit_token shown once. No wallet or API key. Rate limited per IP. Same as POST /v1/receipts.

agent_id.description: Optional id of the agent that will pay. Not a BotSupply API key.

agent_name.description: Optional display name of the paying agent.

approver.description: Display name or handle of the human who approved the purchase.

approver_contact.description: Optional email or phone. Stored only as a hash and never shown on the receipt.

external_payment_ref.description: Optional id from the payment rail. BotSupply does not look it up.

merchant_url.description: Optional http or https URL for the merchant.

payment_rail.description: How the agent will pay. Examples: stripe_link, card, x402, botsupply_wallet.

price_cap_amount.description: Maximum amount approved. A positive decimal, for example 25 or "19.95".

price_cap_currency.description: Currency code, 3 to 10 letters, for example USD or USDC.

scope.description: What the human approved, in plain text.

name: record_approval
title: Record purchase approval
